properties.name: Belső-Máriahegy
properties.method: Manual interpretation of separately labelled fine-quarter outlines on the exact original embedded JPEG of the 2021 consultation-draft municipal figure 81. Manually identified source-stroke seeds guide continuous 8-neighbor source-pixel paths. For the literal-source layer every dense vertex has maxRGB <= 45. Only exactly collinear vertices are removed. A metric affine fit in EOV/EPSG:23700 using five literal contemporary OSM-node coordinates and manually placed approximate old-image road junctions georeferences the source pixels; the result is converted to WGS84. No current-road replacement, source-frame closure, arbitrary chord, buffer, geometric snapping or geometry repair is used.
properties.sourcePeriod: 2021 May municipal consultation draft; underlying orthophoto date unknown.

sourceRaster.pixelCoordinateConvention: Integer source-pixel indices; x right, y down; top-left (0,0), no half-pixel offset.

labelOcclusionInterpretation.lengthMeaning: Boundary edges touching a non-black interpreted vertex, not an accuracy bound.

reviewNotes: These are separately labelled fine source outlines, not the combined Széchenyiváros–Máriahegy planning extent.
Geographic output vertices derive from historical source pixels; they are not original OSM vertices.
Literal contemporary OSM junction coordinates locate the image approximately; manually chosen old-image points and source line width have uncalibrated uncertainty.
Control residuals and the held-out visual check do not establish absolute boundary accuracy.
Current fine names, legal/cadastral status and address assignment are not independently established.
properties.license: Municipal source-map reuse rights not independently established; ODbL-1.0 applies to OSM georeferencing controls.
properties.attribution: Source: Kecskemét MJV Megalapozó Vizsgálat II, May 2021 consultation draft, Figure 81; geographical controls ©OpenStreetMap contributors.
